verdict.rationale: The 01 docs point to guides for assembling your own device, including ESP32-based portable builds, and the repo lists an ESP32 client implementation. So first-party hardware build guidance exists, but its depth is unproven. missing for 10: an explicit bill of materials, wiring diagrams, firmware flashing steps, confirmation that the guides run end to end, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, hardware rigs come with a bill of materials, wiring, and flashing steps I can follow end to end

citations.quote: Find guides for assembling your own 01 device.
Explore various hardware configurations, from desktop setups to ESP32-based portable builds and custom integrations.
